initialExam.title: Punjab Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Punjab Police Constable recruitment for constable posts in Punjab state police force including district police and armed police.
initialExam.syllabus: GK, Current Affairs, Punjab GK, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, Punjabi, English.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours. Physical Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Measurement Test → Physical Screening Test → Medical → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit punjabpolice.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension
